signal: Janus International announced the Noke Infinite dual-technology wireless smart lock for self-storage, shipping Q3 2026

email.body1:
Ramsay, saw Janus announce Noke Infinite, the new dual-technology smart lock shipping in Q3.

A product launch like that usually surfaces more in-market storage operators than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Noke off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Ramsay, quick follow-up for Noke.

A new lock launch usually lifts the pipeline target faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to book to hit it, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Noke needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Ramsay, last bit of proof for Noke.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Noke's reply rate likely compares to other proptech and hardware teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Ramsay, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and a product launch run-up is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Noke either way.
